transitions.description: Draft packages may move into planning approval only when an owner team is attached.
Engineering-validated packages may move to judge review only when judge and evidence bundle references are attached.
Planning-approved packages may move to engineering validated only when validation, execution, and rollback evidence is attached.

diagnostics.LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION_MISSING: The execution record must provide transition.from and transition.to.
diagnostics.LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED: The requested lifecycle transition is not in this deterministic rule set.
diagnostics.LIFECYCLE_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED: The execution record is missing an artifact required by the allowed transition.
